name: Yeshchyo raz pro Olgu
source:
Semyon is in love with Olga. On his fiftieth anniversary cycle, he decides to confess his feelings to her. But will Olga reciprocate? After all, to her, Semyon is just a teenager, a minor.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1177978202]Steam[/url]]
translation:
谢苗爱上了奥尔加。在他的五十周年纪念日，他决定向她坦白自己的感情。但奥尔加会回报吗？毕竟，对于她来说，谢苗只是一个少年，一个未成年人。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1177978202]Steam[/url]]
